title: Chicken Highway

sourceFacts: The official road presentation source specifies25 EASY,23 MEDIUM and19 HARD lanes and exact coefficient arrays. First EASY1.02x crossing/cashout was directly observed; later coefficients are display-source facts.
unresolved: The directly played first EASY crossing does not prove all future lane outcomes or other difficulties.
Provider survival probabilities, full visual/audio parity, native autoplay and8second-disconnection cashout remain unverified or unimplemented.

wallet.existingLimitsNote: Cannot establish actual limits without configured deployed game

tests.scope: Current and historical shared-suite totals are not individual tests per title; per-title browser result is retained separately

deployment.note: Existing URL identifies prior prototype/reference viewer; it is not proof the completed account-only release is deployed.

gameplayViewports.scope: Actual official gameplay observer page and captures

viewport.scope: historical launch audit only; gameplay observations specify own viewport if captured

launchCanvasDimensions.scope: historical launcher snapshot; not proof of completed play or final responsive geometry

geometry.tableProvenance: Official public loaded index.js display arrays; probabilities not inferred
geometry.scene: Desert roadside chicken and cactus on left; traffic lanes, passing cars and hubcap multipliers to right

observationJournal.symbolsColorsTextButtonPlacement: See cited screenshots/observations; not comprehensively verified
